This image shows a theater production credits page. At the top, there's an artistic black and white illustration or design element that appears to be abstract brushstrokes or shapes with some cloudy elements.

Below this graphic are extensive production credits organized in two columns, listing everyone involved in what appears to be a French theatrical production. The credits include actors, directors, technical staff, and creative contributors. The text indicates it's an adaptation of a work by William Faulkner, with translation by François Pitavy and René-Noël Raimbault, and direction by Séverine Chavrier.

The document lists numerous production elements including lighting, sound, video, costumes, set design, and mentions various partnering theaters and organizations including Comédie de Genève, Centre dramatique national Orléans, and several other European theaters. At the very bottom, the word "THÉÂTRE" appears, confirming this is a theatrical program or credit sheet.
